text: Baymard Institute: 69.8% of shopping carts are abandoned. Top reasons: extra costs (48%), forced account creation (24%), complex checkout (17%). Simplifying the path from CTA to checkout reduces abandonment by 20-35%.
CXL Institute: Adding social proof (reviews, ratings, trust badges) near the primary CTA increases conversion rates by 12-17% on average. Effect is strongest for high-consideration purchases (>$50).

Google research: A 1-second delay in mobile page load decreases conversions by 20%. Above-the-fold content must render within 2.5 seconds (LCP). Urgency overlays that increase LCP should be lightweight (<5KB).

NNGroup: Message match between ad copy and landing page headline is the #1 factor in reducing bounce rate from paid traffic. Users who see the same headline on the landing page as the ad are 2.5x more likely to convert.
For SaaS landing pages, countdown timers and urgency messaging DECREASE trust and conversion by 8-12%. SaaS buyers prefer proof of value (case studies, ROI calculators) over time pressure.
Sticky mobile CTAs increase mobile conversion rates by 15-25% on ecommerce product pages. The CTA should appear only when the original button scrolls out of viewport to avoid visual clutter.

Luxury and premium brands should AVOID aggressive urgency tactics (red countdown bars, 'LIMITED TIME'). Instead use exclusivity language: 'Members Only', 'Curated Selection', 'Reserve Yours'. Urgency on luxury pages decreases perceived value by 30%.
